evidence_items.explanation: The paper describes next-token prediction and acknowledges insecure suggestions, supporting the narrower concern that generation does not guarantee correctness. It studies earlier models and does not establish that 2024 generators lack substantive program analysis.

Predicting program inputs and outputs tests behavior beyond whether generated code looks plausible. These earlier model results are material counterevidence to a blanket denial of code reasoning, but do not directly measure the target-period Copilot configuration.

unresolved_gaps: No matched evaluation was obtained that isolates the generator in the relevant mid-2024 Copilot configuration and distinguishes surface plausibility from substantive behavioral analysis.
Prediction-based training and insecure outputs do not establish an absence of learned program semantics.
